why: The first event this producer has emitted that populates accounting.unresolvedRecords. Captured rather than derived: there is no natural residual on the demo corpus, which resolves 23/23, so the unresolved case had to come from a request that legitimately falls outside the artifact rather than from a transformation of a resolving run.
howTheResidualIsReal: The subject is jaffle_shop.main.customers, a dataset genuinely present in the live catalog. The workspace artifact supplied is the Transfermarkt one. The join therefore reports repository-mismatch on a real comparison of two real identities — the dataset is not invented, the mismatch is not simulated, and the name in the record is the URN that was requested.
transport: official DataHub MCP server over stdio — datahub 3.4.5
note: A point capture against a live instance that has been observed to move. Meaningful as an existence proof of the unresolved path, not as a statement about the catalog.
